method: Actual UI controls. Boundary scenarios seed only tutorial/unlock/chapter metadata; no HP/energy/items/turn/win writes. These are separate from fresh-storage natural8chapter acceptance.
checks: First tutorial and event never advance without confirmation
Chapter8 is locked on fresh progress; menu close resumes exact event
Event preview and cancel preserve budget, order and log
Scout confirms once with exact12shields and extra ether
Skill preview actual affinity/cost and Escape cancellation are free
Held Enter/repeated confirmation consumes one action and one energy charge
Revive has no legal target while all companions live
Skill hotkeys, arrows, Enter preview and Escape work without changing battle
Pause freezes initiative/status/ledger and resumes with same resources
Help and chapter book pause and close back to exact battle
Original sound toggle has state and local persistence
Expanded log includes each event/player/enemy/status in order
Actual ether gain clamps at8, decrements once and disables exhausted item
Actual wounded ally healing consumes finite item and records actual bounded HP gain
Pause/reload reconstructs18 full physical fields including items and statuses, then ordinary win
Retry resets authored budget and retains best/unlock
Refresh cancels unconfirmed preview without payment or extra turn
Natural KO clears statuses/energy; dead target rejects healing; ordinary revive restores30 exactly once without insertion
Natural defeat displays single result; terminal inputs do not consume; retry is playable
Live enemy mist weakness and shields survive exact checkpoint restore
Ordinary澄心 clears actual enemy weakness with exact skill cost
Malformed storage falls back to safe fresh chapter
Combat snapshot forgeries cannot grant HP or inventory
Denied localStorage remains playable through normal first-chapter win
Entire normal first battle through native focus/Enter keyboard skill-target-confirm controls
320/360/390/768/1024/1440 width and modal fit without page overflow
Native touchscreen first chapter event/skill/target/preview/confirm and result hit testing
